core_obligations: Quasi-compactness gives a finite standard cover D_+(f_i); set d equal to the product of the degrees.
D_+(f_i) = D_+(f_i^{d/d_i}) forces Y inside W_d, giving parts (1) to (4) through the where-invertible card.
Part (5) is the principal-open card; parts (6) and (7) hold because the D_+(f) form an affine basis of the topology of X.
proof_roadmap: Take the finite cover, set d, establish the containment, then route each of the seven conclusions through its engine.
difficulty_reason: Finite-cover assembly with d the product of the chart degrees, each conclusion routed to a named engine; fully displayed.
